Definition: from G2596 and a derivative of G4639; to overshade, i.e. cover:--shadow.
BiblicalUsage: Over the ark were the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat, of which we cannot now speak particularly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the overshadowing cherubim guarded a mercy too deep for words, and the silence is part of the reverence.
